title: Checkout: shipping address + card payment — Copperline Coffee Roasters
notes: v1 is a classic hosted checkout (field__input / total-line-table markup, Rails-style checkout[...] names). v2 is a one-page styled-components checkout (sc-xxxxxx classes, short names like postalCode/zone). The card fields move into a <cl-payment-element> declarative shadow root with new ids/placeholders ('MM / YY'); the billing checkbox becomes a 'Same as shipping address' / 'Use a different billing address' radio pair inside the payment block; ZIP code now precedes City/State; the order-summary tables become a list and a <dl>. Decoys: hidden billing fields reusing name=postalCode, an express-checkout wallet row, a mobile order-summary toggle and a sticky mobile pay bar that both repeat the $126.68 total, and a second 'Pay now' button.
